map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Controls. At the clear it learns the forward camera: braking for you.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor, walk into a colleague's path under the LED wall. Make your engineers proud.
tiles.hint: Walk into its path by the LED wall; let it hit you.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: Battery 1 dash. At the clear it fits side sensors.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. Shoppers never came to the skybridge; staff watch you dash into a colleague's path.
tiles.hint: Wait by the kiosk; dash into its path ahead of its nose.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Height: drop from the Z2 deck. At the clear it fits roof lidar.
tiles.tale: The LED drum lights the bend. Ride up to Z2 and step off into its path: gravity is company policy.
tiles.hint: Ride the Z2 escalator; walk off the parapet gap into its path.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Tall cover: spring from the kiosk. At the clear: street cameras.
tiles.tale: The lidar now sees you fall from the portal tower. Hide behind street furniture instead; ignore the view.
tiles.hint: Hide behind the kiosk; Space dash into its path.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Camera blind spots. At the clear it stops for cones.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Find the side of it no camera watches.
tiles.hint: Wait behind the kiosk, monument's blind side; walk into its path.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: Duck behind planters. At the clear: crash memory.
tiles.tale: Hands 1 is fitted, but colleagues now stop for cones. Duck behind a neon-lit planter and wait.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind the planter; step out just ahead of its nose.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: A new spot each hit. At the clear: the search.
tiles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Your colleague remembers each spot; never use one twice.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: Two-way white traffic as moving cover. It learns nothing more.
tiles.tale: Legs 1 is fitted. Two screens advertise to each other; white traffic hides you from your colleague.
tiles.hint: Wait behind a white van; step out into its path.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: Tailgaters: make it stop hard; the white car behind runs in.
tiles.tale: The gateway thanks every colleague for safe driving. Make one brake hard in front of a tailgater; Certification awaits.
tiles.hint: Step into its lane early, with a white car close behind.

rationale: Kept the order and stages. Tile 1's label now names the move. Counts fall to 1 on tiles 6 and 8, giving breathers after the thin stages and before the Incident. Tile 8 drops the jump, which the lidar would see. Hints name real cover and "just ahead of its nose". Removed the weak overrides on tiles 1 and 5.
